24.original: Use the Ananta healing salve on wounded Resistance fighters.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, our ssscouts, they've been attacked! Left for dead by sssome territorial predator!

49.original: The messenger who limped into camp sssays they were ssset upon along their patrol route in Virdjala.

50.original: They're in need of immediate attention, and I have no other sssoldiers to sssend. Quickly, take this healing sssalve and find our injured comrades!

52.original: Wait, what is that you're smearing on...oh. Oh! The pain is gone!

53.original: Thank you! I think...yes, I can make it back on my own now.

54.original: <gasp> Well, that's it then.<hex:02100103>I'm done for...

55.original: My thanks─you've dragged me back from death's doorstep! I've walked this route a time or two and thought I knew what to expect... I'll be more careful on my way back to the castellum.

58.original: I don't know what was in that ointment, but it seems the bleeding's stopped. I'd best report in. My thanks!

59.original: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─all the ssscouts are accounted for.

60.original: Were you perhapsss curious about the sssalve I had you use? It is an old Ananta remedy that numbs the wound and clotsss the blood...for a time.

61.original: As sssuch, these ointmentsss are perfect for emergency treatment out in the field. For long term healing, however, the ressstorative alchemies of your people are far sssuperior.

62.original: The Gatekeepers will, of course, ssseek to employ the bessst combination of both. Thank you again for your ssswift assistance.
